career_ladder.note: Promotional hierarchy for LDC / Junior Stenographer in the U.T. Administration of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu governed by Central 7th CPC Pay Matrix and DP&AR Office Memoranda issued from Secretariat, Daman. LDC enters at Level 2; subsequent promotions to UDC (Level 4), Assistant / Head Clerk / Information Assistant (Level 6, Group B Non-Gazetted), Superintendent Group B Gazetted (Level 7), and Administrative Officer / DANICS Entry Grade (Level 10) follow seniority-cum-merit DPC process.

steps.years: Entry level (direct recruitment via SSB DNH & DD Combined Higher Secondary Level Exam)
steps.notes: Group C Non-Gazetted Ministerial entry point. 80-mark CBT + 20-mark domicile weightage = 100-mark merit list. Qualifying computer typing test 35 wpm English / 30 wpm Hindi. Governed by DP&AR OM No. 1/1/87-CS/PF/1804 dated 29/08/2017.
steps.source_label: DP&AR Secretariat Daman OM No. 1/1/87-CS/PF/1804 dated 29/08/2017 — Direct Recruitment Guidelines for Group C posts including Clerical cadre via SSB DNH & DD

steps.years: Minimum 8 years regular service in Level 2 + passing prescribed Departmental Promotion Examination
steps.notes: Group C Non-Gazetted Ministerial. Promotion from LDC (Level 2) to UDC (Level 4) by DPC. Final seniority list issued vide DP&AR OM No. 1/133/90-PER/PART-B/1397 dated 19/07/2018.
steps.source_label: DP&AR Secretariat Daman OM No. 1/133/90-PER/PART-B/1397 dated 19/07/2018 — Final Seniority List of Upper Division Clerks as on May 2018 (feeder cadre from LDC Level 2)

steps.designation: Assistant / Head Clerk / Information Assistant / Confidential Assistant
steps.years: Promotion from UDC (Level 4) feeder cadre by DPC (minimum ~5 years service in Level 4)
steps.notes: Group B Non-Gazetted. Unified cluster: Assistant, Head Clerk, Information Assistant, Confidential Assistant, Civil Registrar-cum-Sub-Registrar, Labour Inspector, PRO, Liaison Officer (Level 6 / PB-2 GP 4200 pre-revised). Inter-se seniority governed by DP&AR OM No. 1/133/90-PER/PART-C/1080 dated 12/06/2018.
steps.source_label: DP&AR Secretariat Daman OM No. 1/133/90-PER/PART-C/1080 dated 12/06/2018 — Final Inter-Se Seniority List of Feeder Cadre Posts (Assistant / Head Clerk / Information Assistant / Confidential Assistant / CRSR / Labour Inspector / PRO / Liaison Officer)

steps.years: Minimum 3 years regular service in Level 6 feeder grade
steps.notes: Group B Gazetted. Promotion from Level 6 feeder grade by DPC. Gazetted and Non-Gazetted Superintendent cadres merged vide Order No. 4/1/88-PER/(Pt.II)/1963 dated 15/10/2015. Recruitment Rules proposed vide Notification No. 4/1/88-PER/(pt.II)/1580 dated 02/08/2016.
steps.source_label: DP&AR Secretariat Daman Notification No. 4/1/88-PER/(pt.II)/1580 dated 02/08/2016 — Proposed Recruitment Rules for post of Superintendent Group B Gazetted (merger; feeder Level 6 with 3 years service)

steps.designation: Administrative Officer / Assistant Director / DANICS Entry Grade
steps.years: Promotion via DPC or direct entry through UPSC DANICS
steps.notes: Group A Gazetted. Top-of-ladder promotion for Superintendent cadre officers via DPC, or direct entry through UPSC Daman & Diu, Dadra and Nagar Haveli Administration Combined Services (DANICS). Ceiling for the typical clerical promotion channel within UT administration.
steps.source_label: U.T. Administration of DNH & DD — Central 7th CPC Pay Matrix Level 10 applicable to Group A Gazetted posts (Administrative Officer / DANICS Entry Grade)

exam_scheme.note: Selection for LDC / Junior Stenographer posts by Staff Selection Board, UT DNH & DD via two stages: (1) Computer Based / OMR Written Examination (competitive, 80 marks + 20 marks local domicile weightage = 100-mark merit list) and (2) Computer Typing / Skill Test (qualifying only). Governed by DP&AR OM No. 1/1/87-CS/PF/1804 dated 29/08/2017. Recruitment fee Rs.100 non-refundable, no exemption. No interview for Group C posts.

stages.stage_name: Stage 1: Computer Based Examination (CBT) / OMR-Based Written Test
stages.source_label: DP&AR Secretariat Daman OM No. 1/1/87-CS/PF/1804 dated 29/08/2017 — Clauses 4 and 6: 80 MCQs x 1 mark, -0.25 penalty per wrong answer, 33% qualifying cutoff; merit = 80 written + 20 domicile; Exam mode CBT or OMR as decided by Board

papers.paper_name: General Intelligence & Reasoning (20 Qs x 1 mark)
Quantitative Aptitude / Numerical Aptitude (20 Qs x 1 mark)
English Language & Comprehension (20 Qs x 1 mark)
Local Domicile Weightage (UT DNH & DD Mamlatdar Domicile Certificate holders only)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Credited only after securing >= 33% in the 80-mark written test; total merit out of 100 marks

stages.source_label: DP&AR Secretariat Daman OM No. 1/1/87-CS/PF/1804 dated 29/08/2017 — Clause 5: Skill Test / Physical Test wherever prescribed in Recruitment Rules shall only be of qualifying nature

papers.paper_name: Computer Typing Test (35 wpm English OR 30 wpm Hindi)
papers.qualifying_threshold: 35 words per minute in English OR 30 words per minute in Hindi on computer

financial_package.pay_source_label: 7th CPC Pay Matrix Level 2 (Rs.19,900 - Rs.63,200) applicable to Group C Ministerial posts including LDC / Junior Stenographer in UT DNH & DD Administration (DP&AR OM No. 1/1/87-CS/PF/1804 dated 29/08/2017)
financial_package.estimate_note: Estimated gross monthly pay at entry (Level 2, Basic Rs.19,900): Basic Rs.19,900 + DA 58% = Rs.11,542 + HRA Class Z rate 9% = Rs.1,791 (minimum Rs.1,800 as per CG norms) for Daman, Diu, DNH districts (classified Class Z HRA city) + TPTA Rs.1,350 + 58% DA on TPTA Rs.783 = Rs.2,133. Gross approximately Rs.35,375. In-hand deducts: NPS Tier-I employee contribution 10% of (Basic + DA) = Rs.3,144; CGEGIS premium approximately Rs.30; income tax nil at this level under new regime. Net in-hand approximately Rs.31,200 - Rs.31,900. Pay scale Level 2 (Rs.19,900 - Rs.63,200) with 3% guaranteed annual increment.
official_perks: Central 7th CPC Pay Matrix Level 2 scale (Rs.19,900 - Rs.63,200) with guaranteed 3% annual basic pay increment
Central Dearness Allowance revised bi-annually (January and July) by Cabinet — 58% of Basic Pay as of 2025-07-01 (Rs.11,542/month at entry)
House Rent Allowance at Class Z city rate 9% of Basic Pay (minimum Rs.1,800/month) for Daman, Diu, Dadra & Nagar Haveli districts, or Government residential accommodation in lieu
Transport Allowance Rs.1,350 + applicable DA (Rs.783 at 58% DA) = Rs.2,133/month
National Pension System (NPS) Tier-I with 14% employer matching contribution by Central Government
Medical attendance and reimbursement under Central Government Medical Attendance Rules / CS (MA) Rules or CGHS empanelled hospitals in UT
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) as per Central Government rules (Home Town / All India twice in 4-year block)
Children Education Allowance (CEA) Rs.2,812.50/month per child (max 2 children) and Hostel Subsidy Rs.8,437.50/month as per DoPT OM
Performance Related Incentive / Productivity Linked Bonus as applicable to Central Government Group C employees
Annual increment compounding at 3% in Level 2 scale

competition_benchmarks.note: The Staff Selection Board (SSB), UT DNH & DD is a small UT recruitment board with limited cadre strength and infrequent Combined Higher Secondary Level / LDC cycles. The April 2026 MCQ cycle for Forester (DNH) confirmed SSB's exam pattern: 100-mark composite merit, 59 candidates in merit list, top score 80.75/100. LDC recruitment cycles typically show 30-150 vacancies across all UT departments. The Diu Municipal Council LDC selection (August 2026) selected 2 from 3 shortlisted candidates, illustrating the small-cadre appointment pattern of this UT. Competition ratios for domicile-resident candidates are approximately 8-15 per post; open-market 20-40 per post.

years.note: Forester-DNH District MCQ Exam held 18/04/2026 — 59 candidates in provisional merit list (100-mark composite scale); top score 80.75/100. Confirms SSB MCQ exam format (80-question CBT + 20-mark domicile). This is a Forestry post but uses identical selection architecture as LDC.
